title: 一個釘孔三百塊
subject: a young tenant moving out of a Taipei rental whose landlord walks the walls with a torch charging NT$300 for every nail hole, until he digs up his move-in photos proving three of the holes were already there
caption: Mandarin G-funk rap, 1990s West Coast style. A high whining portamento synth lead over a deep rubbery Moog-style bass; a talk box answering the hook; a laid-back drum machine with crisp handclaps; warm Rhodes chords on the offbeat. Sunny low-end with a slow rolling groove, dry upfront vocal. Male baritone rapper in a relaxed, conversational flow, talk-box voice replying in the chorus. 90 BPM, A minor. Smug, petty and triumphant. No trap hi-hats, no autotune, no EDM drop, no rock guitars, no pop ballad strings.
lyrics:
[Intro - whining portamento synth lead, talk box hum, deep Moog bass]

[Verse 1]
退租那天房東拿著手電筒
牆上一個一個點過去
掛月曆的 掛鑰匙的
他說一個釘孔三百塊

[Pre-Chorus]
我說那顆是上一個房客
他說你有證據嗎

[Chorus]
一個釘孔三百塊
我的押金一洞一洞不見
房東你慢慢數
我在旁邊幫你算

[Verse 2]
我回家翻出搬進來的照片
放大放大再放大
左邊那三顆早就在了
日期寫得清清楚楚

[Pre-Chorus]
他把手電筒關掉
清了清喉嚨說喝茶嗎

[Chorus]
一個釘孔三百塊
三顆退回九百塊
房東你慢慢數
這次換我拿手電筒

[Bridge - talk box and bass only]
牙膏抹一抹 補土塗一塗
你看不出來 我也看不出來

[Outro - synth lead whines and fades over the bass]
